title: The call window keeps clear of the reader's header and side panel (SurfaceHost 1.2 insets)

tasks.title: Pin SurfaceHost 1.2 and give the fake host chrome insets
The call window reads the reader's insets, with a fallback and a single report for bad values

acs.text: WHEN the pinned host contract is updated THE SYSTEM SHALL carry SurfaceHost 1.2 with an optional `ui.chrome: { get(): { top: number; inlineStart: number; inlineEnd: number; bottom: number }; subscribe(cb): Unsubscribe }` (CSS pixels the reader's chrome occupies at each edge of the viewport), with the reader commit it came from and its hash recorded, and `factory doctor` passing
scenarios: AC-001 the pinned contract is 1.2 with optional chrome insets

acs.text: WHEN the host offers `ui.chrome` THE SYSTEM SHALL place and clamp the call window inside the viewport minus those insets, and re-place it whenever `subscribe` fires (for example the side panel opening at the inline end)
scenarios: AC-002 the window moves out of the side panel's way

acs.text: WHEN the host is SurfaceHost 1.0 or 1.1 (no `ui.chrome`) THE SYSTEM SHALL use fallback insets (top 64, others 0), without an error
scenarios: AC-003 an older reader without insets

acs.text: WHEN `ui.chrome.get()` returns a value that is not four finite numbers between 0 and the viewport's size, or throws THE SYSTEM SHALL use the fallback insets and report `av.error` with kind `chrome_invalid` once per page
WHEN tests and the harness run THE SYSTEM SHALL offer `ui.chrome` on the fake host with insets a test can set, and a way to build a 1.1 host without it
scenarios: AC-005 the fake host offers insets
